Mathematical & Formal Specifications

Formalized statements and Mathlib-only encoding

Every endpoint is formalized at two levels: inside the subject library (Characterizations/Equivalences.lean, RankTwoTauTilting.lean, ComponentMultiplicity.lean) and independently in Statement.lean using Mathlib alone.

Statement.lean (Mathlib-only) ↗ Challenge.lean ↗ MainTheorems.lean (bridge) ↗ 44-result concordance ↗

1. Complete reference for Theorem A: (E-fin) and its 22 characterizations

Let Λ be a finite-dimensional algebra over a field k of rank n = |sim Λ| (written A := Rᵐᵒᵖ in Statement.lean). Baseline condition (E-fin) states that every integral class g = [P0] − [P−1] ∈ K0(proj Λ) is represented by a two-term presilting complex (HomKb(proj Λ)(U, U[1]) = 0).

Tag Scope Mathematical statement Complete formulation in Statement.lean
(E-fin) any k Every g ∈ K0(proj Λ) is the class of a two-term presilting complex (K0(proj Λ) ⊆ Σ(Λ)). EFinite A
(K₀-Hom) any k For all M, N ∈ mod Λ, if [M] = [N] ≠ 0 in K0(mod Λ), then HomΛ(M, N) ≠ 0. ∀ X Y : Mod A, cl X = cl Y → cl X ≠ 0 → ∃ f : X ⟶ Y, f ≠ 0
(mon-dim) any k For every torsion class 𝒯 ⊆ mod Λ, the dimension-vector map M(𝒯) → K0(mod Λ) is injective. MonoidDimension A
(comp-tors) any k Every singly generated (compact) torsion class ⊥(M⊥) in mod Λ is functorially finite. ∀ M : Mod A, FunctoriallyFinite (leftPerp (rightPerp M))
(num-disj) any k For every torsion pair (𝒯, ℱ) and nonzero X ∈ 𝒯, Y ∈ ℱ, [X] ≠ [Y] in K0(mod Λ). ∀ T F : ObjectProperty (Mod A), TorsionPair T F → ∀ X Y, T X → F Y → ¬ IsZero X → ¬ IsZero Y → cl X ≠ cl Y

(wide₁) any k For every brick B ∈ brick Λ, the filtration subcategory Filt(B) is functorially finite. ∀ B : Mod A, Brick B → FunctoriallyFinite (Filt B)

(n-sbrick) any k The set sim Λ of simple modules is the unique n-element semibrick in mod Λ. ∀ s : Set (Skeleton (Mod A)), Semibrick s → s.Finite → s.ncard = (simpleClasses A).ncard → s = simpleClasses A
(fin-sbrick) any k Every semibrick in mod Λ is finite. ∀ s : Set (Skeleton (Mod A)), Semibrick s → s.Finite
(brick-discrete) any k For every r ≥ 1, only finitely many classes in brick Λ have endolength r. ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → (classes (fun X : Mod A ↦ endolength k X = r ∧ Brick X)).Finite
(endo-stab) any k For every θ ∈ K0(proj Λ) and r ≥ 1, only finitely many θ-stable bricks have endolength r. ∀ (P Q : Proj A) (r : ℕ), 0 < r → (classes (fun X : Mod A ↦ endolength k X = r ∧ Stable k P Q X)).Finite
(poly-brick) any k The number of isomorphism classes of bricks of composition length ≤ m grows at most polynomially in m. PolynomialGrowth A
(no-gen-brick) any k There is no infinite-dimensional generic brick in Mod Λ. ¬ ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} A, GenericBrick k M
(no-gen-grain) any k There is no generic grain in Mod Λ. ¬ ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} A, GenericGrain k M
(thick-gen) any k Every thick subcategory of K[−1,0](proj Λ) is thick(U) ∩ K[−1,0](proj Λ) for a two-term presilting U. ThickGeneration A
(univ-loc) any k Every universal localization of Λ at a set of projective morphisms is finite-dimensional over k. LocalizationFinite (k := k) R
(ring-epi) any k Every ring epimorphism Λ → Γ with simple Artinian target satisfies dimk Γ < ∞. SimpleEpicFinite (k := k) R

(dim-stab) k infinite For every θ ∈ K0(proj Λ) and class d, only finitely many θ-stable bricks have class d. ∀ (P Q : Proj A) (c : K₀ A), (classes (fun X : Mod A ↦ cl X = c ∧ Stable k P Q X)).Finite
(moduli-pt) k = k̄ For every θ ∈ K0(proj Λ) and d ∈ ℕn, King's moduli scheme ℳθss(Λ, d) has at most one closed point. ∀ C : Chart k R, C.KingCondition

2. Theorem B, Corollary C, and the five Challenge endpoints

Challenge.lean checks five standalone theorems against Solution.lean:

  1. Challenge.arbitraryField — Theorem A(I): the seventeen arbitrary-field equivalences above.
  2. Challenge.infiniteField — Theorem A(II): the two dimension-vector equivalences (dim-brick) and (dim-stab) over infinite fields.
  3. Challenge.algebraicallyClosedField — Theorem A(III): existence of a split basic Morita chart (Nonempty (Chart k R)) and the equivalences with (moduli-pt), (open-brick), and (open-wide) across all such charts.
  4. Challenge.rankTwo — Theorem B: when |sim Λ| ≤ 2 over any field, Λ is E-finite iff Λ is τ-tilting finite iff Λ is brick-finite.
  5. Challenge.brickDiscreteMultiplicityFree — Corollary C (Weyman's conjecture): over an algebraically closed field of any characteristic, (dim-brick) holds iff every GL(d)-semi-invariant weight space on every irreducible component of rep(Λ, d) has dimension ≤ 1.

3. Encoding conventions in Statement.lean

Why a separate Statement.lean? A large proof library inevitably introduces internal helper structures. Stating the endpoints directly over Mathlib in Statement.lean (~625 lines) lets a human mathematician verify that the formalized definitions match the paper without auditing 388 proof files.

  • Right modules via opposite rings: Right modules over a finite-dimensional k-algebra R are left modules over Rᵐᵒᵖ: Mod Rᵐᵒᵖ := FGModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ for mod Λ and ModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ for Mod Λ.
  • Projective lattice & integral weights: Lattice A is the quotient of the free abelian group on finitely generated projectives by isomorphism and biproduct relations, and integral weights are pairs P Q : Proj A acting on M via dim_k Hom(Q, M) - dim_k Hom(P, M).
  • Dimension vectors & Grothendieck monoids: K₀ A is the quotient of the free abelian group on Mod A by short exact sequences. For a torsion class T, ExactMonoidRel T generates the additive congruence of short exact sequences inside T on Multiset {X // T X}.
  • Two-term thick subcategories: Differential.realize places a map P ⟶ Q in degrees −1 and 0 of HomotopyCategory (Mod A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ); equivalence between the triangulated envelope in K(mod A) and in Kᵇ(proj A) is proved in BoundedProjectiveHomotopy.lean.
  • Basic Morita charts and King's Proj: Over k = k̄, representation varieties require vertex idempotents of a basic algebra. Chart k R packages any split basic k-algebra C.A equipped with a complete set of primitive orthogonal idempotents and an equivalence Mod Rᵐᵒᵖ ≌ Mod C.A, constructs kingProj = AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (kingGrading …) directly from Mathlib's projective spectrum, and proves both existence of a chart and invariance across all charts.

4. Theorem A in the proof library & standalone Challenge.lean

In the proof library (Characterizations/Equivalences.lean), the three field layers of Theorem A have the following Lean signatures: 

variable (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R]

/-- **Theorem A(I):** Over an arbitrary field, E-finiteness `(E-fin)` is equivalent to each of
the seventeen conditions `(K₀-Hom)` through `(ring-epi)`, listed in manuscript order. -/
theorem equivalences_arbitraryField :
    letI := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite k Rᵐᵒᵖ
    letI := IsArtinianRing.of_finite k Rᵐᵒᵖ
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ EqualClassHom (FGModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ)) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ T : ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ),
      T.IsClosedUnderQuotients → T.IsClosedUnderExtensions → T 0 →
      Function.Injective (GrothendieckMonoid.dimensionMap T)) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ M : FGModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ, FunctoriallyFinite (generatedTorsionClass M)) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ NumericallyDisjointTorsionPairs (FGModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ)) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ W : ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ), IsWideClass W → FunctoriallyFinite W) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ B : FGModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ, IsBrick B → FunctoriallyFinite (FilteredBy B)) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ BrickLabels Rᵐᵒᵖ) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ s : Set (Skeleton (FGModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ)), IsSemibrick s → s.Finite →
      s.ncard = (simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ).ncard → s = simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ s : Set (Skeleton (FGModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ)), IsSemibrick s → s.Finite) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → (brickClassesOfEndolength (R := Rᵐᵒᵖ) k r).Finite) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (g : ProjectiveClass Rᵐᵒᵖ) (r : ℕ), 0 < r →
      (stableClassesOfEndolength k (projectiveClassWeight k g) r).Finite) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ PolynomialBrickGrowth Rᵐᵒᵖ) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ¬ ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ, IsGenericBrick k M) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ¬ ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} Rᵐᵒᵖ, IsGenericGrain k M) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ H : TwoTerm Rᵐᵒᵖ → Prop, TwoTerm.IsBoundedTwoTermThick H →
      ∃ U : TwoTerm Rᵐᵒᵖ, U.IsPresilting ∧ ∀ X : TwoTerm Rᵐᵒᵖ,
        H X ↔ (ObjectProperty.singleton U.inBoundedProjectives).triangEnvelope X.inBoundedProjectives) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ RightUniversalLocalizationsFinite k R) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (B : Type u) [Ring B] [IsSimpleRing B] [IsArtinianRing B] (f : R →+* B)
      (hf : IsRingEpimorphism f), letI := hf.targetAlgebra k; Module.Finite k B)

/-- **Theorem A(II)** (Corollary 5.4): Over an infinite field, E-finiteness is also equivalent to
finiteness of bricks of each dimension vector `(dim-brick)` and finiteness of `θ`-stable bricks
of each dimension vector `(dim-stab)`. -/
theorem equivalences_infiniteField [Infinite k] :
    letI := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite k Rᵐᵒᵖ
    letI := IsArtinianRing.of_finite k Rᵐᵒᵖ
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ d : simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ → ℕ,
      (brickClassesOfClass (classOfCompositionVector k d)).Finite) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (g : ProjectiveClass Rᵐᵒᵖ) (d : simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ → ℕ),
      (stableClassesOfClass (projectiveClassWeight k g) (classOfCompositionVector k d)).Finite)

/-- **Theorem A(III)** (Theorem 6.1): Over an algebraically closed field, E-finiteness is also
equivalent to `(moduli-pt)` (at most one closed point in each King moduli space), `(open-brick)`
(every brick has an open orbit), and `(open-wide)` (every wide locus is open). -/
theorem equivalences_algebraicallyClosedField [IsAlgClosed k] :
    letI := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite k Rᵐᵒᵖ
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ (basicPresentation k R).KingClosedPointCondition) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ (basicPresentation k R).OpenBrickOrbits) ∧
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ (basicPresentation k R).OpenWideLoci)

/-!
# Independent statements of the main results

This file states Theorem A(I–III), Theorem B, and Corollary C of
*Characterizations of E-finite algebras and conjectures on brick-finiteness*
using only Mathlib definitions. The proof library does not import this file for
its internal development; `EFiniteCharacterizations/MainTheorems.lean` connects
the library's theorems to the predicates defined here, and
`scripts/generate_challenge.py` copies this file into `Challenge.lean`.

## Encoding conventions

* **Right modules:** Following the manuscript, all endpoint statements concern
  right modules over a finite-dimensional `k`-algebra `R`, realized in Lean as
  left modules over `Rᵐᵒᵖ` (`Mod Rᵐᵒᵖ = FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ` and `ModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ`).
* **Projective lattice and weights:** `Lattice A` is the split Grothendieck
  group `K₀(proj A)` of finitely generated projective modules, and integral
  weights `θ ∈ K₀(proj A)` are represented as differences `[Q] - [P]` of finite
  projectives evaluated via `dim_k Hom(Q, -) - dim_k Hom(P, -)`.
* **Dimension vectors:** Classes `[M] ∈ K₀(mod A)` in the exact Grothendieck
  group (`cl M : K₀ A`) encode dimension vectors, since the classes of the
  simple modules form a `ℤ`-basis of `K₀(mod A)`.
* **Representation varieties and King moduli:** Over an algebraically closed
  field, `Chart k R` packages a Morita-equivalent split basic `k`-algebra `C.A`
  equipped with a complete set of primitive orthogonal idempotents. Theorem
  A(III) proves that every finite-dimensional algebra admits such a chart and
  that the three geometric criteria hold in every chart.
-/

@[expose] public section
open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits
open scoped ModuleCat.Algebra ZeroObject
universe u
namespace EFiniteCharacterizations.Statement

variable (R : Type u) [Ring R]

/-- The category `mod R` of finitely generated left `R`-modules (right modules when applied to `Rᵐᵒᵖ`). -/
abbrev Mod := FGModuleCat.{u} R
/-- Finitely generated projective `R`-modules. -/
abbrev Proj := {P : Mod R // Module.Projective R P}

/-- Isomorphism and direct-sum relations defining the split Grothendieck group `K₀(proj R)`. -/
def splitRelations : AddSubgroup (FreeAbelianGroup (Proj R)) :=
  AddSubgroup.closure
    ({x | ∃ P Q : Proj R, Nonempty (P.val ≅ Q.val) ∧ x = FreeAbelianGroup.of P - FreeAbelianGroup.of Q} ∪
     {x | ∃ P Q T : Proj R, Nonempty (T.val.obj ≅ P.val.obj ⊞ Q.val.obj) ∧
       x = FreeAbelianGroup.of T - (FreeAbelianGroup.of P + FreeAbelianGroup.of Q)})

/-- The split Grothendieck group `K₀(proj R)` of finitely generated projective modules. -/
abbrev Lattice := FreeAbelianGroup (Proj R) ⧸ splitRelations R

variable {R}
/-- The class `[P] ∈ K₀(proj R)` of a finitely generated projective module. -/
def projClass (P : Proj R) : Lattice R := QuotientAddGroup.mk (FreeAbelianGroup.of P)

/-- A two-term projective complex `P → Q` is presilting when `Hom_{Kᵇ(proj R)}(U, U[1]) = 0`,
i.e., every map `P → Q` is null-homotopic along `d`. -/
def Presilting {P Q : Proj R} (d : P.val ⟶ Q.val) : Prop :=
  Function.Surjective (fun t : (P.val ⟶ P.val) × (Q.val ⟶ Q.val) ↦ t.1 ≫ d - d ≫ t.2)

variable (R)
/-- Condition `(E-fin)`: every integral class `[Q] - [P] ∈ K₀(proj R)` is represented by a
two-term presilting complex `P → Q`. -/
def EFinite : Prop := ∀ g : Lattice R, ∃ (P Q : Proj R) (d : P.val ⟶ Q.val),
  Presilting d ∧ projClass Q - projClass P = g

variable [IsNoetherianRing R]

/-- Short-exact-sequence relations defining the Grothendieck group `K₀(mod R)`. -/
def exactRelations : AddSubgroup (FreeAbelianGroup (Mod R)) :=
  AddSubgroup.closure {r | ∃ S : ShortComplex (Mod R), S.ShortExact ∧
    r = FreeAbelianGroup.of S.X₂ - (FreeAbelianGroup.of S.X₁ + FreeAbelianGroup.of S.X₃)}

/-- The exact Grothendieck group `K₀(mod R)`. -/
abbrev K₀ := FreeAbelianGroup (Mod R) ⧸ exactRelations R

variable {R}
/-- The class `[M] ∈ K₀(mod R)` (encoding the dimension vector of `M`). -/
def cl (M : Mod R) : K₀ R := QuotientAddGroup.mk (FreeAbelianGroup.of M)
/-- A finite-dimensional brick: a nonzero module whose nonzero endomorphisms are isomorphisms. -/
def Brick (M : Mod R) : Prop := ¬ IsZero M ∧ ∀ f : M ⟶ M, f ≠ 0 → IsIso f
/-- Isomorphism classes of bricks in `mod R`. -/
def brickClasses : Set (Skeleton (Mod R)) := {s | Brick ((fromSkeleton _).obj s)}
/-- Isomorphism classes of simple objects in `mod R`. -/
def simpleClasses (R : Type u) [Ring R] : Set (Skeleton (Mod R)) :=
  {s | ∃ M : Mod R, toSkeleton M = s ∧ Simple M}
/-- A semibrick: a set of isomorphism classes of pairwise Hom-orthogonal bricks. -/
def Semibrick (s : Set (Skeleton (Mod R))) : Prop := s ⊆ brickClasses ∧
  ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → ∀ f : (fromSkeleton _).obj x ⟶ (fromSkeleton _).obj y, f = 0

/-- Functorial finiteness (both covariantly and contravariantly finite) in `mod R`. -/
def FunctoriallyFinite (T : ObjectProperty (Mod R)) : Prop :=
  (∀ X, ∃ (L : Mod R) (i : X ⟶ L), T L ∧ ∀ Y, T Y → ∀ f : X ⟶ Y, ∃ g, i ≫ g = f) ∧
  (∀ X, ∃ (L : Mod R) (p : L ⟶ X), T L ∧ ∀ Y, T Y → ∀ f : Y ⟶ X, ∃ g, g ≫ p = f)

/-- A torsion pair `(T, F)` in `mod R`: Hom-orthogonality and canonical short exact decompositions. -/
def TorsionPair (T F : ObjectProperty (Mod R)) : Prop :=
  (∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y), T X → F Y → f = 0) ∧
  ∀ X, ∃ (L Q : Mod R) (i : L ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Q) (w : i ≫ p = 0), T L ∧ F Q ∧
    (ShortComplex.mk i p w).ShortExact

/-- The left Hom-perpendicular class `⊥F = {X | Hom(X, F) = 0}`. -/
def leftPerp (F : ObjectProperty (Mod R)) : ObjectProperty (Mod R) :=
  fun X ↦ ∀ Y, F Y → ∀ f : X ⟶ Y, f = 0
/-- The right Hom-perpendicular `B⊥ = {Y | Hom(B, Y) = 0}` of a single module `B`. -/
def rightPerp (B : Mod R) : ObjectProperty (Mod R) := fun Y ↦ ∀ f : B ⟶ Y, f = 0

/-- A wide subcategory of `mod R`: closed under zero objects, isomorphisms, kernels, cokernels, and extensions. -/
structure Wide (W : ObjectProperty (Mod R)) : Prop where
  zero_mem (X : Mod R) : IsZero X → W X
  iso_mem {X Y} : (X ≅ Y) → W X → W Y
  kernel_mem {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y) : W X → W Y → W (kernel f)
  cokernel_mem {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y) : W X → W Y → W (cokernel f)
  extension_mem (S : ShortComplex (Mod R)) : S.ShortExact → W S.X₁ → W S.X₃ → W S.X₂

/-- The subcategory `Filt(B)` of modules admitting a finite filtration with factors isomorphic to `B`. -/
inductive Filt (B : Mod R) : Mod R → Prop where
  | zero {X} (h : IsZero X) : Filt B X
  | extend (S : ShortComplex (Mod R)) (h : S.ShortExact) (e : S.X₁ ≅ B) (q : Filt B S.X₃) :
      Filt B S.X₂

/-- The poset `f-tors R` of functorially finite torsion classes, ordered by inclusion. -/
abbrev FiniteTorsion (R : Type u) [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] :=
  {T : ObjectProperty (Mod R) // (∃ F, T = leftPerp F) ∧ FunctoriallyFinite T}

/-- Defining relations of the Grothendieck monoid `M(T)` of an exact subcategory `T`. -/
inductive ExactMonoidRel (T : ObjectProperty (Mod R)) : Multiset {X // T X} → Multiset {X // T X} → Prop
  | zero (X) (h : IsZero X.val) : ExactMonoidRel T {X} 0
  | iso (X Y) (e : X.val ≅ Y.val) : ExactMonoidRel T {X} {Y}
  | exact (S : ShortComplex (Mod R)) (h : S.ShortExact) (a : T S.X₁) (b : T S.X₂) (c : T S.X₃) :
      ExactMonoidRel T {⟨S.X₂,b⟩} ({⟨S.X₁,a⟩} + {⟨S.X₃,c⟩})

/-- Condition `(mon-dim)`: for every torsion class `T`, the dimension-vector map `M(T) → K₀(mod R)` is injective. -/
def MonoidDimension (R : Type u) [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] : Prop :=
  ∀ (T : ObjectProperty (Mod R)), T.IsClosedUnderQuotients → T.IsClosedUnderExtensions → T 0 →
    ∀ X Y (hx : T X) (hy : T Y), cl X = cl Y →
      (addConGen (ExactMonoidRel T)) {⟨X,hx⟩} {⟨Y,hy⟩}

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R]

/-- The endolength of a brick `M`, computed as `dim_k M / dim_k End_R(M)`. -/
noncomputable def endolength (M : Mod R) : ℕ :=
  Module.finrank k (M.obj : Type u) / Module.finrank k (M.obj ⟶ M.obj)

/-- Evaluation `⟨[Q] - [P], [M]⟩ = dim_k Hom(Q, M) - dim_k Hom(P, M)` of an integral weight on `M`. -/
noncomputable def weight (P Q : Proj R) (M : Mod R) : ℤ :=
  (Module.finrank k (Q.val.obj ⟶ M.obj) : ℤ) - Module.finrank k (P.val.obj ⟶ M.obj)

/-- Stability of a nonzero module `M` at the integral weight `θ = [Q] - [P]`:
`θ(M) = 0` and `θ(U) < 0` for every nonzero proper submodule `U ⊊ M`. -/
def Stable (P Q : Proj R) (M : Mod R) : Prop :=
  ¬ IsZero M ∧ weight k P Q M = 0 ∧ ∀ {U : Mod R} (i : U ⟶ M) [Mono i],
    ¬ IsZero U → ¬ IsIso i → weight k P Q U < 0

/-- A generic brick: an infinite-dimensional `R`-module whose endomorphism ring is a division ring
over which it has finite length (equivalently, is finitely generated). -/
def GenericBrick (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) : Prop :=
  ¬ Module.Finite k M ∧ (∀ f : Module.End R M, f ≠ 0 → Function.Bijective f) ∧
    Module.Finite (Module.End R M) M

/-- A generic grain: an infinite-dimensional indecomposable endofinite module `M` such that
`Ext¹_R(X, M) = 0` for every finite-dimensional module `X` cogenerated by `M`. -/
def GenericGrain (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) : Prop :=
  ¬ Module.Finite k M ∧ Indecomposable M ∧ IsFiniteLength (Module.End R M) M ∧
    ∀ S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R), S.ShortExact → Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ M) → Module.Finite k S.X₃ →
      (∃ (n : ℕ) (f : S.X₃ →ₗ[R] (Fin n → M)), Function.Injective f) → ∃ s : S.X₃ ⟶ S.X₂, s ≫ S.g = 𝟙 S.X₃

/-- Isomorphism classes of modules in `mod R` satisfying `T`. -/
def classes (T : ObjectProperty (Mod R)) : Set (Skeleton (Mod R)) := {s | ∃ M, toSkeleton M = s ∧ T M}

variable (R)
/-- Brick-finiteness: `mod R` has only finitely many isomorphism classes of bricks. -/
def BrickFinite : Prop := (brickClasses (R := R)).Finite

local instance : HasFiniteBiproducts (Mod R) := HasFiniteBiproducts.of_hasFiniteCoproducts

/-- `τ`-tilting finiteness, formulated via finiteness of basic `τ`-tilting modules (cokernels of
two-term presilting complexes with `n = |sim R|` nonisomorphic indecomposable summands). -/
def TauTiltingFinite : Prop :=
  let n := (simpleClasses R).ncard
  {s : Skeleton (Mod R) | ∃ M : Mod R,
    (∃ (P Q : Proj R) (d : P.val ⟶ Q.val), Presilting d ∧ Nonempty (cokernel d ≅ M)) ∧
    (∃ X : Fin n → Mod R, (∀ i, Indecomposable (X i)) ∧ Function.Injective (toSkeleton ∘ X) ∧
      Nonempty ((⨁ X) ≅ M)) ∧ toSkeleton M = s}.Finite

/-- Statement of Theorem B: in rank `n ≤ 2` over any field, E-finiteness is equivalent to
`τ`-tilting finiteness and to brick-finiteness. -/
def RankTwo : Prop :=
  ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R],
    letI := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite k Rᵐᵒᵖ
    (simpleClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ).ncard ≤ 2 →
      (EFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ TauTiltingFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ) ∧ (EFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ BrickFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ)

/-- A two-term projective presentation `source → target` in `K^{[-1,0]}(proj R)`. -/
structure Differential where
  source : Proj R
  target : Proj R
  d : source.val ⟶ target.val

variable {R}
/-- A ring homomorphism `f : R →+* B` inverts a projective morphism `D` when `Hom_R(D.d, B)` is bijective. -/
def Differential.inverts (D : Differential R) {B : Type u} [Ring B] (f : R →+* B) : Prop :=
  letI := Module.compHom B f
  Function.Bijective (fun g : D.target.val.obj ⟶ ModuleCat.of R B ↦ D.d.hom ≫ g)

/-- Universal property of the universal localization `R →+* B` at a set `S` of projective morphisms. -/
def Localization (S : Set (Differential R)) {B : Type u} [Ring B] (f : R →+* B) : Prop :=
  (∀ D ∈ S, D.inverts f) ∧ ∀ (C : Type u) [Ring C] (g : R →+* C),
    (∀ D ∈ S, D.inverts g) → ∃! q : B →+* C, q.comp f = g

/-- A categorical epimorphism in the category of rings. -/
def RingEpic {B : Type u} [Ring B] (f : R →+* B) : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Type u) [Ring C] (g h : B →+* C), g.comp f = h.comp f → g = h

open CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated

/-- Realization of a two-term presentation in degrees `-1` and `0` of `K(mod R)`. -/
noncomputable abbrev Differential.realize (D : Differential R) :=
  (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj
    (HomologicalComplex.double D.d (show (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel (-1) 0 from rfl))

/-- Canonical contractible zero presentation `0 → 0`. -/
def zeroDifferential (R : Type u) [Ring R] : Differential R :=
  let Z : Proj R := ⟨FGModuleCat.of R PUnit, inferInstance⟩
  ⟨Z,Z,𝟙 Z.val⟩

/-- A thick subcategory of `K^{[-1,0]}(proj R)`: contains `0`, satisfies two-out-of-three on
distinguished triangles among two-term complexes, and is closed under retracts. -/
def Thick (H : Differential R → Prop) : Prop :=
  H (zeroDifferential R) ∧
  (∀ (A B C : Differential R) (f : A.realize ⟶ B.realize) (g : B.realize ⟶ C.realize)
    (h : C.realize ⟶ A.realize⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧), Triangle.mk f g h ∈ distTriang _ →
    (H A → (H B ↔ H C)) ∧ (H C → (H B ↔ H A))) ∧
  ∀ A B : Differential R, Retract A.realize B.realize → H B → H A

variable (R)
/-- Condition `(thick-gen)`: every thick subcategory of `K^{[-1,0]}(proj R)` has the form
`thick(U) ∩ K^{[-1,0]}(proj R)` for a two-term presilting complex `U`. -/
def ThickGeneration : Prop :=
  ∀ H : Differential R → Prop, Thick H → ∃ U : Differential R,
    Presilting U.d ∧ ∀ X, H X ↔ (ObjectProperty.singleton U.realize).triangEnvelope X.realize

/-- Condition `(brick-label)`: every brick `B` labels a cover `T ⋖ U` in `f-tors R` via `Filt(B) = U ∩ T⊥`. -/
def BrickLabels : Prop :=
  ∀ B : Mod R, Brick B → ∃ T U : FiniteTorsion R, T ⋖ U ∧
    ∀ X, Filt B X ↔ U.val X ∧ ∀ Y, T.val Y → rightPerp Y X

/-- Condition `(poly-brick)`: the number of bricks of composition length `≤ m` grows at most polynomially in `m`. -/
def PolynomialGrowth : Prop :=
  ∃ a n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ,
    let C := classes (fun X : Mod R ↦ Brick X ∧ (Module.length R X).toNat ≤ m)
    C.Finite ∧ C.ncard ≤ a * (m + 1) ^ n

/-- Condition `(univ-loc)`: every universal localization of `R` is finite-dimensional over `k`. -/
def LocalizationFinite : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Set (Differential Rᵐᵒᵖ)) (B : Type u) [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (f : R →ₐ[k] B),
    Localization S (AlgHom.op f).toRingHom → Module.Finite k B

/-- Condition `(ring-epi)`: every ring epimorphism from `R` to a simple Artinian ring has finite `k`-dimension. -/
def SimpleEpicFinite : Prop :=
  ∀ (B : Type u) [Ring B] [IsSimpleRing B] [IsArtinianRing B] (f : R →+* B),
    RingEpic f → letI := Module.compHom B (f.comp (algebraMap k R)); Module.Finite k B

/-- Statement of Theorem A(I): the seventeen arbitrary-field equivalences `(E-fin)` through `(ring-epi)`,
in manuscript order. -/
def ArbitraryField : Prop :=
  ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R],
    let A := Rᵐᵒᵖ
    letI := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite k A
    let E := EFinite A
    (E ↔ ∀ X Y : Mod A, cl X = cl Y → cl X ≠ 0 → ∃ f : X ⟶ Y, f ≠ 0) ∧
    (E ↔ MonoidDimension A) ∧
    (E ↔ ∀ M : Mod A, FunctoriallyFinite (leftPerp (rightPerp M))) ∧
    (E ↔ ∀ T F : ObjectProperty (Mod A), TorsionPair T F → ∀ X Y,
      T X → F Y → ¬ IsZero X → ¬ IsZero Y → cl X ≠ cl Y) ∧
    (E ↔ ∀ W : ObjectProperty (Mod A), Wide W → FunctoriallyFinite W) ∧
    (E ↔ ∀ B : Mod A, Brick B → FunctoriallyFinite (Filt B)) ∧
    (E ↔ BrickLabels A) ∧
    (E ↔ ∀ s : Set (Skeleton (Mod A)), Semibrick s → s.Finite →
      s.ncard = (simpleClasses A).ncard → s = simpleClasses A) ∧
    (E ↔ ∀ s : Set (Skeleton (Mod A)), Semibrick s → s.Finite) ∧
    (E ↔ ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → (classes (fun X : Mod A ↦ endolength k X = r ∧ Brick X)).Finite) ∧
    (E ↔ ∀ (P Q : Proj A) (r : ℕ), 0 < r →
      (classes (fun X : Mod A ↦ endolength k X = r ∧ Stable k P Q X)).Finite) ∧
    (E ↔ PolynomialGrowth A) ∧
    (E ↔ ¬ ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} A, GenericBrick k M) ∧
    (E ↔ ¬ ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} A, GenericGrain k M) ∧
    (E ↔ ThickGeneration A) ∧ (E ↔ LocalizationFinite (k := k) R) ∧ (E ↔ SimpleEpicFinite (k := k) R)

/-- Statement of Theorem A(II): over an infinite field, E-finiteness is also equivalent to
`(dim-brick)` (Schur-representation-finiteness) and `(dim-stab)`. -/
def InfiniteField : Prop :=
  ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Infinite k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R],
    let A := Rᵐᵒᵖ
    letI := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite k A
    (EFinite A ↔ ∀ c : K₀ A, (classes (fun X : Mod A ↦ cl X = c ∧ Brick X)).Finite) ∧
    (EFinite A ↔ ∀ (P Q : Proj A) (c : K₀ A),
      (classes (fun X : Mod A ↦ cl X = c ∧ Stable k P Q X)).Finite)

end EFiniteCharacterizations.Statement

namespace EFiniteCharacterizations.Statement

section
open MvPolynomial TopologicalSpace

variable {k σ X : Type*} [Field k]

/-- The Zariski topology on a parameter set given by its affine coordinates. -/
@[instance_reducible] noncomputable def coordinateZariski (c : X → σ → k) : TopologicalSpace X :=
  TopologicalSpace.induced (fun x ↦ pointToPoint (k := k) (c x)) inferInstance
end

section
variable {k R : Type u} [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R]
variable {ι m n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]

/-- Matrices of the action of the chosen algebra basis on a based module. -/
noncomputable def actionMatrices (b : Module.Basis ι k R) {M : FGModuleCat.{u} R}
    (v : Module.Basis m k (M.obj : Type u)) (j : ι) : Matrix m m k :=
  LinearMap.toMatrix v v (Algebra.lsmul k k (M.obj : Type u) (b j))
end

section
variable {k R I : Type u} [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [DecidableEq I]

/-- The prescribed space at each vertex, with its fixed coordinates. -/
abbrev VertexSpace (k : Type u) (d : I → ℕ) := (i : I) → Fin (d i) → k

variable (d : I → ℕ)

/-- Coordinate projection onto the `i`-th vertex summand of `VertexSpace k d`. -/
noncomputable def vertexProjection (i : I) : Module.End k (VertexSpace k d) :=
  (LinearMap.single k (fun i ↦ Fin (d i) → k) i).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

variable (e : I → R)

/-- The representation variety `rep(A, d)` of algebra actions on `VertexSpace k d` sending each
vertex idempotent `e i` to the `i`-th coordinate projection. -/
def VertexRepresentation := {ρ : R →ₐ[k] Module.End k (VertexSpace k d) //
  ∀ i, ρ (e i) = vertexProjection d i}

namespace VertexRepresentation

variable {d e}

/-- The base-change group `GL(d) = ∏_i GL_{d_i}(k)` acting at the vertices. -/
abbrev BaseChange (k : Type u) [Field k] (d : I → ℕ) :=
  ∀ i, (Fin (d i) → k) ≃ₗ[k] (Fin (d i) → k)
/-- Conjugation of the algebra action by an invertible change of basis at each vertex. -/
noncomputable def changeBasis (G : BaseChange k d) (ρ : VertexRepresentation (k := k) d e) :
    VertexRepresentation (k := k) d e := by
  let F := LinearEquiv.piCongrRight G
  refine ⟨(F.conjAlgEquiv k).toAlgHom.comp ρ.val,fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  change F.conjAlgEquiv k (ρ.val (e i)) = _
  rw [ρ.property]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  funext j
  change G j (Pi.single (M := fun t ↦ Fin (d t) → k) i (F.symm z i) j) =
    Pi.single (M := fun t ↦ Fin (d t) → k) i (z i) j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst j
    simp [F,LinearEquiv.piCongrRight_symm]
  · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj]

noncomputable instance : MulAction (BaseChange k d) (VertexRepresentation (k := k) d e) where
  smul := changeBasis
  one_smul ρ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply AlgHom.ext
    intro r
    rfl
  mul_smul G H ρ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply AlgHom.ext
    intro r
    rfl

variable [Fintype I]
/-- The finite module defined by evaluation of an algebra action. -/
noncomputable def moduleObj (ρ : VertexRepresentation (k := k) d e) : FGModuleCat.{u} R := by
  let _ : Module R (VertexSpace k d) := Module.compHom _ ρ.val.toRingHom
  have : IsScalarTower k R (VertexSpace k d) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun c z ↦
    congrArg (fun f : Module.End k (VertexSpace k d) ↦ f z) (ρ.val.commutes c)
  have : Module.Finite R (VertexSpace k d) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k _ _
  exact FGModuleCat.of R (VertexSpace k d)

/-- Coordinates of the underlying module in the prescribed vertex spaces. -/
noncomputable def coordinates (ρ : VertexRepresentation (k := k) d e) :
    (ρ.moduleObj.obj : Type u) ≃ₗ[k] VertexSpace k d where
  toFun := id
  invFun := id
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' c z := congrArg (fun f : Module.End k (VertexSpace k d) ↦ f z) (ρ.val.commutes c)
/-- The total basis is the union of the standard bases at the vertices. -/
noncomputable def vertexBasis (ρ : VertexRepresentation (k := k) d e) :
    Module.Basis (Σ i, Fin (d i)) k (ρ.moduleObj.obj : Type u) :=
  (Pi.basisFun k _).map ((LinearEquiv.piCurry k (fun i (_ : Fin (d i)) ↦ k)).trans ρ.coordinates.symm)

variable {J : Type u} [Fintype J] (b : Module.Basis J k R)

/-- Affine coordinates are the matrix coefficients of the basis elements of the algebra. -/
noncomputable def affineCoordinates (ρ : VertexRepresentation (k := k) d e) :
    J × (Σ i, Fin (d i)) × (Σ i, Fin (d i)) → k := fun (j,a,l) ↦
  actionMatrices b ρ.vertexBasis j a l
/-- The point-set Zariski topology of the fixed-vertex representation variety. -/
@[instance_reducible] noncomputable def zariski :
    TopologicalSpace (VertexRepresentation (k := k) d e) := coordinateZariski (affineCoordinates b)

/-- The vertex summand of a module is the image of the vertex idempotent. -/
abbrev vertexPart (e : I → R) (M : FGModuleCat.{u} R) (i : I) :=
  LinearMap.range (Algebra.lsmul k k (M.obj : Type u) (e i))

end VertexRepresentation
end

namespace VertexRepresentation
section
open scoped DirectSum
variable {k R I J : Type u} [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R]
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J]
    (b : Module.Basis J k R) (d : I → ℕ) (e : I → R)

/-- The character specified by integral exponents on the vertex determinants. -/
noncomputable def vertexCharacter (w : I → ℤ) : BaseChange k d →* kˣ where
  toFun G := ∏ i, (LinearEquiv.det (G i)) ^ w i
  map_one' := by simp
  map_mul' G H := by simp [Pi.mul_apply, mul_zpow, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

/-- Polynomial functions in the action matrices, restricted to the variety. -/
noncomputable def coordinateAlgebra : Subalgebra k (VertexRepresentation (k := k) d e → k) :=
  (MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ρ ↦ affineCoordinates b ρ j)).range

/-- The degree-m part consists of regular functions on which the inverse
pullback action has character χ to the power m. -/
def kingSemiInvariants (w : I → ℤ) (m : ℕ) : Submodule k (coordinateAlgebra b d e) where
  carrier := {f | ∀ (G : BaseChange k d) x, f.val (G⁻¹ • x) =
    ((vertexCharacter d w G : kˣ) : k) ^ m * f.val x}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  add_mem' := by
    intro f g hf hg G x
    change f.val _ + g.val _ = _ * (f.val x + g.val x)
    rw [hf,hg,mul_add]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro a f hf G x
    change a * f.val _ = _ * (a * f.val x)
    rw [hf]
    ring

instance (w : I → ℤ) : SetLike.GradedMonoid (kingSemiInvariants b d e w) where
  one_mem := by intro G x; simp
  mul_mem := by
    intro i j f g hf hg G x
    change f.val _ * g.val _ = _ ^ (i + j) * (f.val x * g.val x)
    rw [hf,hg,pow_add]
    ring

/-- The graded ring whose Proj defines the character quotient. -/
abbrev KingSemiInvariantRing (w : I → ℤ) := ⨁ m : ℕ, ↥(kingSemiInvariants b d e w m)

variable (w : I → ℤ)

abbrev KingPiece (m : ℕ) := ↥(kingSemiInvariants b d e w m)

local notation "A" => KingPiece b d e w

noncomputable instance : CommRing (KingSemiInvariantRing b d e w) :=
  @DirectSum.commRing ℕ _ _ _ _ (SetLike.gcommRing (kingSemiInvariants b d e w))

/-- The homogeneous pieces inside the direct sum ring. -/
noncomputable def kingGrading (m : ℕ) : AddSubgroup (KingSemiInvariantRing b d e w) :=
  AddMonoidHom.range (G := A m) (DirectSum.of A m)

instance : SetLike.GradedMonoid (kingGrading b d e w) where
  one_mem := ⟨_,(DirectSum.one_def _).symm⟩
  mul_mem := by
    rintro i j _ _ ⟨f,rfl⟩ ⟨g,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_,(DirectSum.of_mul_of f g).symm⟩

noncomputable instance : GradedRing (kingGrading b d e w) := by
  let ins (m : ℕ) := AddMonoidHom.rangeRestrict (G := A m) (DirectSum.of A m)
  let deg := kingGrading b d e w
  let split := DirectSum.toAddMonoid (fun m ↦ (DirectSum.of (fun i ↦ ↥(deg i)) m).comp (ins m))
  refine { (inferInstance : SetLike.GradedMonoid deg) with
    toDecomposition := DirectSum.Decomposition.ofAddHom deg split ?_ ?_ }
  · apply DirectSum.addHom_ext
    intro i x
    change (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom deg) (split (DirectSum.of A i x)) = _
    rw [DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
    exact DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of deg i (ins i x)
  · apply DirectSum.addHom_ext
    rintro i ⟨_,x,rfl⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of, split,
      DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
    rfl

/-- The projective GIT scheme for the chosen vertex determinant character. -/
noncomputable def kingProj : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme :=
  AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (kingGrading b d e w)
end

section
variable {k R I J : Type u} [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R]
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] (b : Module.Basis J k R)
    {d : I → ℕ} {e : I → R} (C : Set (VertexRepresentation (k := k) d e))

/-- Regular functions on a component transforming by the specified determinant character.
Regularity is restriction of a polynomial in the action matrices. The transformation
law is imposed on the function itself, independently of its polynomial representative. -/
def componentWeightSpace (w : I → ℤ) : Submodule k (C → k) where
  carrier := {f | (∃ p : coordinateAlgebra b d e, ∀ x : C, p.val x.val = f x) ∧
    ∀ (G : BaseChange k d) (x y : C), y.val = G⁻¹ • x.val →
      f y = (vertexCharacter d w G : kˣ) * f x}
  zero_mem' := ⟨⟨0,fun _ ↦ rfl⟩,by simp⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro f g ⟨⟨p,hp⟩,hf⟩ ⟨⟨q,hq⟩,hg⟩
    refine ⟨⟨p+q, fun x ↦ congrArg₂ (· + ·) (hp x) (hq x)⟩,?_⟩
    intro G x y he
    exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (hf G x y he) (hg G x y he)).trans (mul_add ..).symm
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro a f ⟨⟨p,hp⟩,hf⟩
    refine ⟨⟨a • p,fun x ↦ congrArg (a * ·) (hp x)⟩,?_⟩
    intro G x y he
    change a * f y = _ * (a * f x)
    rw [hf G x y he, mul_left_comm]
end
end VertexRepresentation

/-- A split basic algebra Morita equivalent to the algebra of right modules, together
with its complete vertex idempotents and their dimensions on the simple modules. -/
structure Chart (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Ring R] where
  A : Type u
  [ring : Ring A]
  [algebra : Algebra k A]
  [finite : Module.Finite k A]
  n : ℕ
  vertex : ULift.{u} (Fin n) → A
  complete : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents vertex
  index : simpleClasses A ≃ ULift.{u} (Fin n)
  dimension : ∀ s i, Module.finrank k
    (VertexRepresentation.vertexPart (k := k) vertex ((fromSkeleton _).obj s.val) i) =
      if index s = i then 1 else 0
  equivalence : Mod Rᵐᵒᵖ ≌ Mod A

attribute [instance] Chart.ring Chart.algebra Chart.finite

namespace Chart
open VertexRepresentation
variable {k R : Type u} [Field k] [Ring R] (C : Chart k R)

/-- Chosen `k`-basis of the split basic algebra `C.A`. -/
noncomputable def basis := (Module.finBasis k C.A).reindex (Equiv.ulift.{u}.symm)

/-- Condition `(moduli-pt)`: for every integral weight `w` and dimension vector `d`, King's moduli
scheme `M_w^{ss}(C.A, d)` has at most one closed point. -/
def KingCondition : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : ULift.{u} (Fin C.n) → ℤ) (d : ULift.{u} (Fin C.n) → ℕ),
    let X := kingProj C.basis d C.vertex w
    Set.Subsingleton {x : X | IsClosed ({x} : Set X)}

/-- Condition `(open-brick)`: every brick has a Zariski-open `GL(d)`-orbit in `rep(C.A, d)`. -/
def BrickOrbits : Prop :=
  ∀ d (x : VertexRepresentation (k := k) d C.vertex), Brick x.moduleObj →
    @IsOpen _ (zariski C.basis) (MulAction.orbit (BaseChange k d) x)

/-- Condition `(open-wide)`: for every dimension vector `d` and wide subcategory `W`, the locus
`{x ∈ rep(C.A, d) | x ∈ W}` is Zariski-open. -/
def WideLoci : Prop :=
  letI := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite k C.A
  ∀ d (W : ObjectProperty (Mod C.A)), Wide W →
    @IsOpen (VertexRepresentation (k := k) d C.vertex) (zariski C.basis) {x | W x.moduleObj}

/-- Multiplicity-freeness: on every irreducible component of every `rep(C.A, d)`, each weight space
of `GL(d)`-semi-invariants has dimension at most one. -/
def MultiplicityFree : Prop :=
  ∀ d, ∀ Z ∈ @irreducibleComponents _ (zariski (d := d) (e := C.vertex) C.basis),
    ∀ w, Module.rank k (componentWeightSpace C.basis Z w) ≤ 1
end Chart

/-- Statement of Theorem A(III): over an algebraically closed field, every finite-dimensional
algebra admits a split basic Morita chart, and E-finiteness is equivalent in every chart to
`(moduli-pt)`, `(open-brick)`, and `(open-wide)`. -/
def AlgebraicallyClosedField : Prop :=
  ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R],
    Nonempty (Chart k R) ∧
    (EFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ C : Chart k R, C.KingCondition) ∧
    (EFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ C : Chart k R, C.BrickOrbits) ∧
    (EFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ C : Chart k R, C.WideLoci)

/-- Statement of Corollary C (Weyman's conjecture): over an algebraically closed field of arbitrary
characteristic, Schur-representation-finiteness `(dim-brick)` is equivalent to multiplicity-freeness
on every irreducible component of every representation variety. -/
def BrickDiscreteMultiplicityFree : Prop :=
  ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R],
    let A := Rᵐᵒᵖ
    letI := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite k A
    (∀ c : K₀ A, (classes (fun X : Mod A ↦ cl X = c ∧ Brick X)).Finite) ↔
      ∀ C : Chart k R, C.MultiplicityFree

end EFiniteCharacterizations.Statement

namespace EFiniteCharacterizations.Challenge

/-- **Theorem A(I):** Over an arbitrary field, E-finiteness is equivalent to each of the
seventeen conditions `(K₀-Hom)` through `(ring-epi)`. -/
theorem arbitraryField : Statement.ArbitraryField.{u} := by
  sorry

/-- **Theorem A(II):** Over an infinite field, E-finiteness is also equivalent to
`(dim-brick)` (finitely many bricks of each dimension vector) and `(dim-stab)`. -/
theorem infiniteField : Statement.InfiniteField.{u} := by
  sorry

/-- **Theorem A(III):** Over an algebraically closed field, E-finiteness is also equivalent to
`(moduli-pt)`, `(open-brick)`, and `(open-wide)` in every split basic Morita chart. -/
theorem algebraicallyClosedField : Statement.AlgebraicallyClosedField.{u} := by
  sorry

/-- **Theorem B:** For a finite-dimensional algebra of rank at most two over any field,
E-finiteness, `τ`-tilting finiteness, and brick-finiteness are equivalent. -/
theorem rankTwo : Statement.RankTwo.{u} := by
  sorry

/-- **Corollary C (Weyman's conjecture):** Over an algebraically closed field,
Schur-representation-finiteness `(dim-brick)` is equivalent to multiplicity-freeness on every
irreducible component of every representation variety. -/
theorem brickDiscreteMultiplicityFree : Statement.BrickDiscreteMultiplicityFree.{u} := by
  sorry

end EFiniteCharacterizations.Challenge
